authorship: Hand-authored startup matrix over docs/A1_RECOVERY_CONTRACT.md section 5. No production persistence code exists or was consulted.

laws.blankFirst: Startup renders the blank workspace immediately; the probe never blocks first paint.
laws.noAudio: No startup disposition may initialize audio.
laws.noSilentOverwrite: Recovery never silently overwrites an already edited in-memory document.

expected.law: A valid current envelope with no conflicting session state and no export disagreement opens automatically with a visible explanation and Discard/New actions.
A current envelope that is stale against or disagrees with the stored export binding is offered, never auto-opened.
Editing that began before the probe settled downgrades automatic opening to Keep/Discard; the edited in-memory document is never overwritten.
A corrupt current envelope with a valid previous envelope offers the previous copy.
Neither copy decoding reports one nonblocking diagnostic; the blank workspace stands and editing is unaffected.
A corrupt current with no previous is a nonblocking diagnostic, not an offer.
A missing current slot with a valid previous envelope is offered as the previous copy, never auto-opened.
Session edits and marker disagreement combine to the same Keep/Discard offer; corruption of previous changes nothing here.
With no usable adapter there are no candidates regardless of stored bytes elsewhere.
Every startup path leaves the audio engine untouched; only a later trusted gesture may initialize it.
